messages:
jess: Quick question — I'm about to land a tiny tf change that adds an IAM role + k8s service account mapping for the autoscaler. Need a quick ✅ on secret access pattern before I merge.

omar: Pinged — what's the access boundary? Are we giving the SA direct Vault read or using the webhook token reviewer flow?

jess: Plan was webhook token reviewer + Vault Kubernetes auth (bound service account). No node-level creds. I added annotation: `vault.hashicorp.com/role: redwood-autoscale-read` on the SA in the tf module.

li: Can you paste the tf snippet and the k8s SA manifest? want to sanity-check policy scoping.

jess: Sure — tf change (module snippet):
```hcl
module "autoscaler_sa" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/infra-modules.git//k8s-service-account"
  name   = "redwood-autoscaler"
  namespace = "kube-system"
  annotations = {
    "vault.hashicorp.com/role" = "redwood-autoscale-read"
  }
}
```
and the SA rendered -> annotation is there.

sandeep: That annotation is fine. Two ask: 1) ensure Vault policy is limited to `/secret/data/autoscale/*` and 2) the webhook injector needs the CA bundle in the namespace — did you add the cert config map?

jess: I didn't add the CA configmap in this change. We have one in `infra-common` currently. Should I reference it or duplicate?

omar: reference it. Duplication leads to drift. Instead, update the module to accept `vault_ca_configmap` input.

li: Also, remind folks — Karpenter nodes use a different SA. If autoscaler reads node templates from Vault, we must ensure least privilege — only read the `instance-types` blob, not cluster credentials.

jess: Good call. Vault policy will be tightly scoped. One more thing: HPA/VPA config needs a little tweak — we want to avoid scale-down during secret rotation. My proposal: add annotation `redwood.com/scale-safe-ttl: "120"` to pods the autoscaler manages so scale-down eviction window extends during rotation. Thoughts?

sandeep: I like the intent. Implementation question: who consumes that annotation? Karpenter or HPA controller? We could have a small admission controller that tags metrics or we could configure HPA stabilization window.

omar: Simpler to adjust HPA `behavior` for scaleDown: `stabilizationWindowSeconds: 120`. No new infra needed. Add a note to the rollout docs instead of new annotation.

jess: Sounds good — will change HPA behavior instead. I'll push a second commit for the HPA object. Sample patch: 
```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: model-worker-hpa
  namespace: inference
spec:
  behavior:
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 120
      policies:
        - type: Percent
          value: 10
          periodSeconds: 60
  metrics: [...]
```

li: Also add a PodDisruptionBudget for the stateful parts — set `maxUnavailable: 1` — prevents parallel drain vs scale down.

infra-bot: Deploy check: terraform plan passed for module/autoscaler_sa in staging. No drift detected.

jess: Nice — thanks infra-bot. Last item: secret rotation handshake. Vault rotates creds to a new path then writes an activation flag. We need the autoscaler to back off scale ops for ~2m during activation. I'll add a small check in the controller: if `/secret/autoscale/rotation_status` == "activating" then skip downscales for 120s.

omar: If you add that, add a feature flag and a unit test — and document failure modes (what if the flag is stuck).

sandeep: Also add a chokepoint in tf to create a Kubernetes `ConfigMap` named `autoscale-rotation` in `kube-system` with the webhook updating it on rotation. That makes the handshake visible to ops.

jess: Will do: 1) tf module change to accept `vault_ca_configmap` and create/patch `autoscale-rotation` CM; 2) HPA `stabilizationWindowSeconds` update; 3) controller feature flag + test; 4) docs.

li: Quick CR request: @omar can you look at the Vault policy in PR #492? small, but want to ensure we aren't accidentally giving read to secrets outside `/autoscale/`.

omar: On it, will review in the next hour.

jess: Thanks all — will queue the follow-ups in the PR description. Merge after @omar + CI green. :thumbsup:
